```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"

import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"language\":\"dot\"}", ProcessConfig::class.java)
    val result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("digraph G { A -> B; }", config)
    println(result)
```
